items.reason: Three strata: recurrent medulloblastoma, newly diagnosed HGG '(such as anaplastic astrocytoma, glioblastoma, H3K27-altered DMG)' and DIPG. Medulloblastoma is a non-glioma cancer, so this is a multi-tumour trial with GBM named in the inclusion criteria (basket), not only a mix of glioma types.

note: Outcome-neutral: only investigational agent is the PEP-CMV peptide vaccine (excluded type), so S6 fails either way. Td toxoid is part of the vaccine therapy under D30-R4 (excluded_intervention_type, settling the A supportive / B excluded difference); temozolomide single course is soc_backbone. Ages 3-39 (mixed_age). Basket-vs-mixed choice for CNS multi-tumour trials should be applied consistently (see NCT06753617, NCT05278208).
